name: Bayside Bungalow 9531 3 Bedroom Home
description: Discover the charm of Bayside Bungalow, a beautifully appointed vacation home in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering serene bay views and room for up to 8 guests. This spacious three-bedroom, three-bath getaway is perfect for families or small groups seeking a relaxing coastal retreat with easy water access and modern amenities.
